name: Packages Telemetry
summary: This package defines a telemetry abstraction centered on spans, and provides an in-memory implementation plus a conformance test suite. It ships type-level machinery to validate telemetry schemas so that span names and their attributes are checked at compile time. The API is intentionally minimal (startSpan, setAttributes, addEvent, setStatus) and framework-agnostic, so adapters (like OpenTelemetry) can implement the same interface and pass the same conformance tests.
keyPoints: Defines a minimal TelemetryContext/TelemetrySpan interface with startSpan, setAttributes, addEvent, setStatus — no concrete adapter in this package, only an in-memory one.

The type system enforces telemetry schemas: defineTelemetrySchema() lets you describe spans, their start/end attributes, and events; derived types (TelemetrySchemaSpanStartAttributes, etc.) infer required vs optional attributes and reject unknown ones via ExactTelemetryAttributes.

createTypedSpanStarter() returns a typed starter that enforces the schema at compile time: the span name, its attributes, and the event names/attributes must match the declared schema, and it rejects duplicate span names across schemas.
InMemoryTelemetryContext records spans and events (with copied attribute values) so that tests can inspect them after execution; it also implements failure status propagation.

The package includes a conformance test generator (createTelemetryAdapterConformance) that any adapter can run to verify it behaves like the in-memory implementation — including error propagation and attribute handling.
NOOP_TELEMETRY_CONTEXT provides a no-op implementation for use when telemetry is disabled.

entryPoints.name: defineTelemetrySchema
entryPoints.note: Entry point for declaring a telemetry schema that constrains span names, attributes, and events at the type level.

entryPoints.name: createTypedSpanStarter
entryPoints.note: Creates a typed span starter bound to a TelemetryContext and a schema tuple, enforcing schema correctness at compile time.

entryPoints.name: InMemoryTelemetryContext
entryPoints.note: In-memory implementation of TelemetryContext that records spans and events for later inspection (used by tests and as a reference adapter).

entryPoints.name: NOOP_TELEMETRY_CONTEXT
entryPoints.note: No-op TelemetryContext that swallows all telemetry calls; useful as a default when telemetry is disabled.

entryPoints.name: createTelemetryAdapterConformance
entryPoints.note: Generates a set of conformance tests that a telemetry adapter must pass to behave correctly (used to validate new adapters).
